summary.result: The load weight and material property drawn from this study can be used as the basic material for the stability analysis of the personal disaster evacuation apparatus.
summary.background: The houses are formed in the lower part of the mountain slope face in most agricultural areas of Korea, and old residents accounting for a large portion of the agricultural populations cannot respond to the evacuation quickly when the landslide happens, and the possibility the life damage occurs is high.
summary.method: This study suggested the load applicable to the personal disaster evacuation apparatus by quantitatively analyzing the effect of the load of rockslides and avalanches caused by the landslide on the structure.
